title: Darts
paragraphs: “You’re aware that people are attached to you, aren’t you?”
“Well, to a normal extent. But honestly, I don’t want anyone to have to fight.”
Father muttered, a mix of kindness and guilt showing through.
“Before coming to this world, I used to admire battle. But now that I’m actually here, feeling this way… I guess I’m being selfish.”
“No, I understand how you feel. When I was first called a Hero, my heart raced at the thought of the grand adventure that was about to begin.”
“Yeah. I might be different from you all because of VR, but anyone who’s had even a little experience with games probably admired something like this at some point.”
I understand this as well. At first, I also thought of it as one adventure after another. And the fact that a romance with a pig got mixed in there makes it a truly tragic black mark in my past.
“I wish I could have fought alone with a weapon instead of just relying on the shield. It’s a contradiction, but in the end, I have to depend on others.”
“Right person for the right job. We’ve always been saved by Naofumi. Whatever Naofumi can’t do, the rest of us—me, Itsuki, Motoyasu, everyone—can handle.”
“Exactly. This world is in an age of war, so someone has to fight.”
“Yeah… Thanks.”
Hmm, Ren and Itsuki occasionally say some good things.
“Going back to the topic, I feel the same way about Sakura-chan, Windia-chan, and Gaelion-chan.”
“Nano… Gaelion won’t give up, nano!”
“Haa…”
The assistant sighed at the rival’s response.
This Motoyasu will never allow Father to be given to the rival!
“In the previous loops, Father lamented, wondering if he wasn’t actually a lolicon.”
“I seriously have no idea what kind of person I was in all those past loops…”
“Being good at taking care of others… Fatherly love and romantic feelings are separate things, after all.”
“I wonder what kind of person could actually fall in love with Naofumi-san.”
“Why does everyone assume I have such a ridiculously narrow strike zone?”
Father tilted his head in confusion. He seemed quite close with the older sister. Thinking back, in the first world, there was an air of him being somewhat open to accepting certain things.
“Well, the first woman he met in another world was *that*, right? Maybe something inside him is subconsciously holding him back.”
“Come on, just being a Hero probably means marriage proposals would come my way. And, well… I’m still a virgin, so at least once, I’d…”
Father trailed off mid-sentence. Because at the edge of his vision, the rival’s eyes were shining with excitement. There’s no doubt about it—he’s aiming for him.
Even if he tries to make a move, I will stop him!
“…For now, I don’t really care about romance.”
“Father is pure and righteous! It is most admirable!”
“The confidence of someone who’s not a virgin? That kinda ticks me off.”
“Hahaha! Virginity is a status, I say! It means you are unable to display your pure and untarnished self to others!”
“That’s a terrible thing to say…”
“I can understand valuing female virginity, but I wouldn’t want to be someone who envies male virginity.”

Father looked exasperated, while Ren and Itsuki sighed. If they don’t understand the value in this, they’re still just kids. Honestly, the fact that only female virginity is treated as special is irritating. I might as well coin a new term like ‘Virgin Snow’ to elevate it.
“Naofumi, that’s not what Imia means. Even if she finds her relatives, she doesn’t want to part ways with you… with us.”
At Ren’s words, the mole nodded repeatedly.
“I see… She wants to become stronger so she doesn’t have to say goodbye. She’s afraid that if she only has a trade, she’ll be left behind.”
“Yes…”
“It’s okay. Imia-chan should be the one to decide. We just want to make sure she has a place where she can always return, whenever she wants.”
The mole blushed slightly before giving a quiet nod.
“Sewing, huh…? If we asked Motoyasu-kun, it’s not impossible. And I’m already handling the cooking. Ren was planning to take care of smithing, right?”
“You still remember that?! Just let the country handle it already…”
“Imia-chan aside, wouldn’t Ren ultimately need to do it? Some weapons seem to have useful skills embedded in them, and if you mastered smithing, you’d probably surpass the country’s blacksmiths.”
Ren looked incredibly annoyed.
“And I’ve been completely left out of the discussion, I see.”
Itsuki is irrelevant. He can go use his bow to gather ingredients for Father’s cooking.
Not that it matters, since I’ll get there first with my spear!
“Wouldn’t it be better if Itsuki changed his weapon to a gun? And his equipment could have a gunslinger style too.”
“That’s not a bow or anything, but it’s easy to carry, and the rapid-fire capability seems like it would make it strong. But that’s a different matter.”
“If only you could apply your accuracy skill to something else.”
“How about a gambler who specializes in darts? You’d probably be good at billiards too.”
“Billiards…? That’s not really a profession or anything.”
“Well, you can figure out what you can do together with Imia as you go.”
Itsuki looked at the mole and responded gently.
“That’s true. Let’s learn what we can do from now on.”
“Y-yes. I want to be able to create something so amazing that even the people of the country can’t replicate it…”
It was quite a heartwarming scene.
“By the way, the meeting… when do you think it’ll be?”
“Probably in the evening? I mean, it’s kind of amazing how this country still functions with a king that does whatever he wants.”
“Storming into Melromarc might be an option, but there are too many things we need to handle first… Have we been granted permission for class upgrades?”
Father turned to Éclair, who had been assigned by the queen to support us. It seems she was officially designated as our personal knight.
“I just checked, and it seems so. You should go and raise Yuki-dono’s abilities.”
“Alright then. Let’s handle Sakura-chan and the others’ class upgrades first. I wanted to stop by and see Melty-chan anyway.”

And so, Father went to pick up Sakura-chan and the others from Fiancée’s place and returned. It seems nothing noteworthy happened. Fiancée, knowing that they would be leaving in the evening, made preparations for departure and then returned to the queen. Father then picked up Yuki-chan and the others, and we made our way to the Dragon Hourglass in Faubrey. Speaking of which, Faubrey’s Dragon Hourglass isn’t managed by a religious group but rather a national department—a guild-like general facility. It looks like a temple. The location itself is within one of the towns past the courtyard of the royal district where Faubrey’s royalty resides. It’s a difficult place to describe. Faubrey is divided into sections for commoners and nobles, and the hourglass is located in the noble district. Since the facility is used not only for class upgrades but also for the criminal punishment of level resets, it seems more fitting that the state manages it rather than a religious group. However, the road leading to the Dragon Hourglass was blocked off by Faubrey’s soldiers.
“Halt! The Dragon Hourglass is currently—oh, you are the Four Holy Heroes.”
“Is it sealed off?”
“Yes! At present, a faction of serious criminals is being escorted for execution via level reset, so general adventurers are prohibited from approaching the hourglass.”
“Does that include us?”
“No! The King of Faubrey has granted the Four Holy Heroes permission to use it, so even during an execution, you are allowed to proceed.”
So, class upgrades in the middle of a criminal sentencing? That feels rather unpleasant.
Especially since it’s Yuki-chan and the others’ upgrades—it’s all the more uncomfortable! Father noticed my slight displeasure and let out a sigh.
“That said, if we don’t do it now, we’ll be heading to Melromarc by this evening. Enduring it for now will ultimately be for Sakura-chan and the others’ benefit.”
“Understood! This Motoyasu shall endure, even if it is unpleasant!”
“You picked up on that quickly.”
“We’ve been together long enough that I’ve come to understand some of Motoyasu-kun’s sense of aesthetics…”
Itsuki looked impressed by Father. Father and I are completely in sync.
“Then let’s proceed with the class upgrades.”
“Understood. Please, go ahead.”
The soldiers stepped aside, and we proceeded toward the temple housing Faubrey’s Dragon Hourglass. Inside, we saw a large number of pigs shackled at the wrists and ankles, being dragged along.
So these are the serious criminals, huh?
